name: Validate upstream runtime drift
prompt: Check the managed GitHub issue `Upstream runtime drift` and the authoritative checkout's upstream-runtime-policy.json. If there is no actionable drift, stay quiet and do nothing. Otherwise follow docs/AUTOMATION_POLICY.md and the user's existing authority: validate package integrity, patch compatibility, focused tests, relevant Oracle no-submission behavior and actual DevSpace access; require a merged PR and exact-commit Windows/macOS/Linux CI before release. Do not require audit nonces, fixed tool ordering, three receipts, or repeated qualification. Preserve the configured commander, model/effort choice, authentication, approved roots, and historical runs. Stable patch/minor changes retain existing standing approval only after relevant checks pass; major/breaking, permission/OAuth changes, conflicts, failures, ambiguity, or an unsafe restart require explicit user authority. Never mutate project content or account settings, execute a moving latest package, stop foreign active work, or automatically resubmit a prompt. Report only meaningful change, completion, failure, or required user action. This source contract does not itself register or change a host automation.
